context: Compose a poem all in lowercase letters about my friend Barnet.

trace.content:
barnet walks with quiet feet
through fields of golden wheat
his laughter is a sudden rain
that washes off the afternoon pain

he knows the way the shadows fall
and how the river starts to call
no grand design or loud display
just kindness in the simple way

when storms roll in and skies turn gray
he finds a brighter, softer day
a steady hand and open ear
the best of friends i've ever near

so here's to barnet, plain and true
the world is better with you
in lowercase letters, soft and deep
a promise that the world will keep
